Add Expenditure Type Share of Income and Catastrophic Spending Flag

Source: R/add_expenditure_item_share_income.R
add_expenditure_type_share_income.Rd

Calculates the share of a single expenditure type relative to total income normalising both to the same recall period before computing the ratio, and flags households where that share meets or exceeds the catastrophic threshold.

The share is computed as: (expenditure * income_recall_period) / (income * expenditure_recall_period)

Prerequisite: cm_income_total (or the column supplied to income_total) must already be present in df, either from the survey directly or from add_income_source_prop().

Usage

add_expenditure_type_share_income(
  df,
  expenditure_type,
  income_total = "cm_income_total",
  expenditure_recall_period = 30,
  income_recall_period = 30,
  catastrophic_threshold = 0.25
)

Arguments

df

A data frame.

expenditure_type

Column name for the expenditure amount.

income_total

Column name for the total household income.

expenditure_recall_period

Recall period of the expenditure column in days. Default: 30.

income_recall_period

Recall period of the income column in days. Default: 30.

catastrophic_threshold

Numeric threshold above which spending is considered catastrophic (proportion, e.g. 0.25 for 25%). Default: 0.25.

Value

A data frame with two additional columns (names derived from expenditure_type):

  • {expenditure_type}_share_income: Recall-normalised share of expenditure relative to income; 1 for zero-income households with expenditure above 0; NA if income or expenditure is NA.

  • {expenditure_type}_share_income_d: 1L if share >= catastrophic_threshold, 0L if share is below the threshold or for a zero-income household with zero expenditure, NA_integer_ if income or share is NA.

See also

Other expenditure_share_income: add_expenditure_healthcare_share_income(), add_expenditure_water_share_income()

Examples

df <- data.frame(
  cm_expenditure_infrequent_health = c(60, 0, 30),
  cm_income_total = c(100, 200, 0)
)
add_expenditure_type_share_income(
  df,
  expenditure_type = "cm_expenditure_infrequent_health",
  income_total = "cm_income_total",
  expenditure_recall_period = 180,
  income_recall_period = 30,
  catastrophic_threshold = 0.25
)
#>   cm_expenditure_infrequent_health cm_income_total
#> 1                               60             100
#> 2                                0             200
#> 3                               30               0
#>   cm_expenditure_infrequent_health_share_income
#> 1                                           0.1
#> 2                                           0.0
#> 3                                           1.0
#>   cm_expenditure_infrequent_health_share_income_d
#> 1                                               0
#> 2                                               0
#> 3                                               1
